title: RAW UNREVIEWED: Pliny nerium: human protection and quadruped harm have different preparation owners
summary: RAW_UNREVIEWED_NOT_SELECTED_NOT_TESTED. The historical rhododendron/nerium entry contrasts quadruped poisoning with a human serpent-protection mixture in wine and rue; sheep/goat water steepings are separately harmful. The same historical plant participates in benefit or harm according to recipient and preparation. Preserve both factors instead of reducing the contrast to animal versus human alone.
